description: Stereo compressor and noise gate with a sidechain

params.text: The level in decibels the detector acts at, from -24dB to +6dB; 0dB is the peak-to-peak output of a standard oscillator. The menu doubles the range
How much the signal is attenuated past the threshold; at the top of the knob's travel the compressor becomes a limiter
How long the detector takes to follow the level upward, up to 500ms
How long the detector takes to follow the level downward, up to 2 seconds
Amplifies both outputs by up to 24dB, after the compressor
Cuts or boosts both inputs by up to 12dB before the detector and the compressor; it does not touch the sidechain
Crossfades the detector's input between the summed left and right signals and the sidechain
RMS averages the input over a short window, PEAK reads its instantaneous level
A softer or harder transition as the signal crosses the threshold

inputs.text: The left signal in; the channels patched here set the polyphony
Sidechain input; IN/SIDE crossfades the detector between the main signal and it
0-10V scaling the threshold knob's position, which puts the threshold at -24dB at 0V
A CV added to the input gain, 5V either way
A CV added to the output gain, 5V either way

outputs.text: The detector's control signal, sent out
That side's signal, compressed or gated and then amplified by the output gain; it soft-clips at 12V

menu: Threshold range — scales what the THRESH knob covers: 1x (-24dB to 6dB) or 2x (-48dB to 12dB)
